title: Spotlight on… Bangkok
summary: This C40 case study describes “Spotlight on… Bangkok,” an urban initiative documented for Bangkok. It is included because it is located in the Global South. C40 describes the action this way: Governor Chadchart Sittipunt discusses the threats that climate crisis impacts pose to Bangkok and how the city is working to implement solutions…

intervention.objectives: Governor Chadchart Sittipunt discusses the threats that climate crisis impacts pose to Bangkok and how the city is working to implement solutions and protect residents.
intervention.measures:
Governor Chadchart Sittipunt discusses the threat that climate crisis impacts pose to Bangkok, and how the city is working to mitigate, adapt, and implement solutions to protect residents.

 This video was originally produced for the C40 World Mayors Summit in Buenos Aires.
